uncited: A proxy geometry mesh defined in 3D space.
A set of Wang squares (2D) and Wang cubes (3D) with associated indices.
The tiling recipes generated by the Wang tilling algorithm.
A mapping from mesh triangle texture coordinates (uv) to Wang square indices.
A mapping from mesh box coordinates (ijk) to Wang cube indices.
*   **Tiling Recipe (2D):** A 2D array containing indices of Wang squares.
*   **Tiling Recipe (3D):** A 3D array containing indices of Wang cubes.
*   **Replication Area:** A 2D region (window) within the 2D tiling recipe.
**Preprocessing (2D Tiling):** Run the Wang tilling algorithm to generate the 2D tiling recipe.
**Preprocessing (3D Tiling):** Extend the algorithm to 3D to generate the 3D tiling recipe.
**Preprocessing (Replication Area):** Identify the largest triangle in the proxy geometry mesh.
Compute the size of the replication area based on this triangle.
**Rendering (Projection):** Determine the subset of tiles from the replication area that are projected onto the specific triangle.
*   **Mesh Complexity:** The replication area size is determined by the *largest* triangle.
*   **Boundary Conditions:** The tiling recipes must be large enough to cover the entire coordinate space.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing two tiling recipes (2D and 3D) and the replication area.
